findings.message: The linked stylesheet "compositions\assets\scene.css" has a rule on #root, the id of this sub-composition's root. The root is merged into its host when the composition is compiled, so that selector matches nothing (the same rule in an inline <style> is rewritten and works).
findings.fixHint: Move the #root rules into a <style> inside the <template>, where they are rewritten for the merged root, or select a child element of the root in the linked file instead of the root itself.
